description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the F1 Score (%) achieved across various datasets for different model configurations. The horizontal category axis, labeled "Dataset," displays six discrete categories in the following order: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI. The vertical value axis, labeled "F1 Score (%)," uses a linear scale ranging from 60 to 100, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 10. Within each dataset category, the data is visually arranged into groups of four adjacent bars, each outlined in black, representing different model variations as defined by the legend below the chart. The green bars represent "MADLLM," the purple bars represent "MADLLM w/o feature embedding," the blue bars correspond to a label partially obscured by a grey rectangle that reads "MADLLM w/o [grey rectangle] pool," and the orange bars represent "MADLLM w/o skip embedding." Across the chart, the approximate values range from a minimum of roughly 62 for the purple bar in the WADI group to a maximum of approximately 97 for the green bar in the PSM group. The categories on the horizontal axis are not sorted alphabetically or by ascending or descending value, and all bars share a uniform visual emphasis with standard black outlines.
